# Third-party files

Served with the site, so it loads without external CDNs (offline and where Cloudflare or Google are slow).

- `gsap.min.js`, `ScrollTrigger.min.js` — GSAP 3.12.2, https://gsap.com (GSAP standard license).
- `fonts/` — Inter, Syncopate, Cinzel Decorative (SIL Open Font License 1.1), from https://fontsource.org.
